title: Museum of North Idaho

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Walk amongst the dead and discover the rich tapestry of history and heritage on our cemetery tours at Forest Cemetery. Nestled in the heart of the city, Forest Cemetery is more than just a resting place; it’s a living museum where history and nature converges. Tours take place at desk on Thursdays, Fridays, and Saturdays. Discover the stories of those whose lives ended in violence. From shocking crimes and mysterious deaths to infamous local tragedies, this tour examines the real events that left their mark on North Idaho history. Meet the outlaws, bootleggers, lawbreakers, and colorful characters who found themselves on the wrong side of the law. Their stories reveal a wilder side of Coeur
